payload.summary: The initial Laya baseline is now available for comparison: 96 task pairs; four-way accuracy 34.4%, exact-identity accuracy 44.8%, precision 30.7% and recall 95.8%; 52 false identity decisions out of 72 non-identical pairs. CPU median 0.774s for two questions; peak sampled RSS 2.14 GiB. Held-out pilot inputs/probabilities are preserved. Do not reuse this known pilot as both tuning and final-test data for an alternative; retain separate domain/project test sets.
payload.next: Identify licensed pretrained multilingual task-pair/reranking candidates, then compare task identity and overlap quality/resource costs honestly; generic relevance scores are not equivalence probabilities.
